vc to cc, 2026-11-26 09:24Z by date -u: Intent 3.5.5 BRIEF, items 3 and 4 (hv decision 115; devbin-vc's GO 09:23Z). Base f42c29118. Work in one worktree, tmp/wt-cc-355, and bank each item on its own ref: refs/bank/cc/i355-done/v1 and refs/bank/cc/i355-doctor/v1.
ITEM 3 (S): `intent wp done` and `intent st done` WARN, and never refuse, when the current branch is not merged into main. Warn only when Intent can tell: a git repo, a named current branch other than main, and a main that resolves. Detached HEAD, no git, or no main: say nothing. The check lives in intentsvcs; the CLI only renders it. ic owns the line's text and shape: agree it with ic before you bank.
ITEM 4 (XS): the root-file-behind line of `intent doctor`, and its remedy, name the binary's path (current_exe) and its version beside the template home. Change the existing tests that pin that line. NO new test. Name each changed arm and why in your handover (devbin-vc's condition).
Each bank: clippy, then the named runs of the arms you touched, on one small Desk ask for cargo. No whole gate. Each bank adds its own one-line CHANGELOG entry under 3.5.5's ### Fixed. hv decision 79: no planted faults. Send me the ref, blob or commit, patch id, base and the named runs.
